title: I'm Not A Perfect Person
trend: TikTok 'I'm not a perfect person' confession trend (admit a funny flaw, then own it; on SocialBee's October 2026 US TikTok list) — acted out at a fall parent-teacher conference
youtube_title: I'm not a perfect person: parent-teacher conference edition 🍎
description:
One dad, one teacher, one pencil sharpener and a class guinea pig. Everybody has something to confess at this parent-teacher conference.

#notaperfectperson #parentteacherconference #backtoschool #momlife #dadlife #comedy #animation #shorts
tiktok_caption: i'm not a perfect person… parent-teacher conference edition 🍎🐹 #notaperfectperson #parentteacherconference #dadlife #fyp

lines.text: Hi. Trevor. Mason's dad. I'm here about the volcano.
Mister Hale. Sit down. We need to talk about the volcano.
Before you say anything. I'm not a perfect person.
It was a meatloaf, Trevor.
It was a volcano made of meatloaf. Very scientific.
It smelled lovely. The whole room had dinner at ten in the morning.
That's Agnes. The pencil sharpener. She has opinions.
I have one opinion. That meatloaf deserved better than a C plus.
Wait. Mason got a C plus?
No. You got a C plus. Mason didn't touch it.
Mason told me you stayed up until two in the morning.
I'm not a perfect person. I wanted it to erupt.
Okay. Since we're being honest. Agnes, anything to share?
Fine. I am not a perfect sharpener.
I've eaten forty pencils this year. Whole.
I keep the erasers. I'm saving them for something.
Can I go next? I've been holding this in since August.
The guinea pig talks?
That's Nugget. Class pet. He only talks at conferences.
I'm not a perfect guinea pig. I get out every night.
I knew it. The glue sticks.
The glue sticks were me. And the pen pal letters.
The class writes to a boy in Ohio. There is no boy in Ohio. It's me.
Mason thinks I have a horse. I said the horse is named Kevin.
Mason talks about Kevin every single day!
Trevor. There's one more thing. Costume day.
I'm not a perfect person. I muted the parent group chat.
It had two hundred messages about a raffle basket. I panicked.
So you sent Mason in a hard hat and called him a man who fixes things.
It was a costume. He fixed the door.
And on snack day, you brought one pickle.
One very large pickle. Family size.
Twenty two children shared one pickle, Trevor.
Okay. Your turn. Teachers aren't perfect either, right?
Fine. I'm not a perfect person.
I knew it was you. I always know. I've graded your homework before.
What?
Room twelve. Nineteen ninety nine. You sat by the window.
Miss Pruitt? You haven't aged at all!
I've aged. I just do it quietly.
And you still owe me a book report. You said your dog ate it.
My dog did eat it!
No. I ate it.
That was twenty seven years ago!
Nobody ever asks how old the class pet is.
I've known for years. We don't talk about it.
I'm not a perfect person. You'll have that book report by Friday.
Do not make it out of meatloaf.
No promises.
Mason gets an A, by the way. He's very honest. He told me everything.
Everything?
Everything. He writes to me in Ohio.
I'm not a perfect person. I'm a guinea pig. Kevin says hi.
